description: This file defines a React component 'ProtectedRoute' that functions as a route guard, ensuring that only authenticated users can access certain routes. It uses React Router for navigation and a custom 'useAuth' hook for authentication status. It also includes a 'LoadingGate' component that displays a loading indicator while verifying authentication.
